about: Azhar Mamdani is a business immigration attorney in Sugar Land, Texas, representing founders, investors, professionals, and companies in U.S. immigration matters. He has a background in accounting and entrepreneurial experience, which informs his work on investor and corporate immigration.

His practice covers business and employment-based immigration. He handles E, H, L, O, P, TN, and other work visas; employment-based green cards; and matters including appeals, RFE and NOID responses, employer I-9 compliance, consular processing, and CBP airport seizures. He also handles company formation, contracts, tax and estate planning. He structures each case into defined milestones, from discovery and preparation through filing and interview preparation.

Azhar is admitted to practice before the U.S. Supreme Court, the U.S. Tax Court, the U.S. Court of Federal Claims, the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of Texas, and all Texas state courts. He is a member of the Million Dollar Advocates Forum and the Multi-Million Dollar Advocates Forum, and has been named a Texas Super Lawyers Rising Star each year from 2023 to 2026.
